design.grid: 13x13 independent efficacy; ve_i and ve_m in 0, 0.075, ..., 0.90
design.seed_schedule: 2026100000+replicate_id, paired across all cells and base arm
design.scenario: community vaccination, 40% coverage, 14-day rollout from day 0, base operations
design.efficacy_mapping: efficacy=ve_i (infection path, sigmoidal ramp k=0.5 d0=10); vax_CFR=base_CFR*(1-ve_m) (mortality path); infection_efficacy_multiplier=1.0
design.base_arm: base operations, no community vaccination, efficacy 0
